citation.authors: Sriperumbuduri S, Umar MS, Lajoie-Starkell G, Fairhead TR et al

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: cortisol, mood, skin, hair, heart, kidneys and liver

record.population: One 69-year-old male kidney transplant recipient, Ottawa, Canada
record.finding: He developed acute rejection requiring removal of the transplanted kidney after using ashwagandha, while taking tacrolimus, mycophenolate and prednisone. The authors recommend warning transplant recipients about herbal products including ashwagandha.
record.note: One case. It cannot show that ashwagandha caused the rejection. I read the introduction and case presentation, not the whole discussion.
